dedupe_keys.name: voie ouverte a la circulation publique reconnue d interet dfci voi

description: Voie ouverte à la circulation publique, reconnue d’intérêt DFCI (VOI) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The layer ‘Way open to public traffic, recognised as being of DFCI interest’ belongs to the DFCI equipment database. It can be filled in by departmental DFCI partners. These are roads open to public traffic, recognised as being of DFCI interest pursuant to the third paragraph of Article L 134-10 of the Forest Code. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Route open to public traffic, recognised as being of interest DFCI (VOI)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Défense des forêts contre les incendies, Forêt, Incendie, DFCI, Voirie. The listing shows 2016-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
